written.description: Produces the compliance artefact as well as the verdict: a CycloneDX or SPDX bill of materials for a model file, alongside the Keras, GGUF and ONNX payloads it found while reading it.

alive.last_commit_message:
fix(sbom): record dependency versions only for exact pins; add pypi purls (#143)

* fix(sbom): record dependency versions only for exact pins; add pypi purls

`torch>=2.0` became a component at version 2.0, a claim about what is
installed that requirements.txt does not make. A dependency now has a
version only for a single ==/=== pin without a wildcard; any other
specifier is kept in the aisbom:requirement:specifier property
(CycloneDX) or the package comment (SPDX 2.3/3.0).

Exact pins carry pkg:pypi/<normalised-name>@<version> as the CycloneDX
purl, an SPDX 2.3 PACKAGE_MANAGER external ref and SPDX 3.0
software_packageUrl, so VEX tooling can join CVE statements by purl.

aisbom diff against an older baseline shows range dependencies as
`<bound> -> unknown`; noted in the CHANGELOG.

* fix(spdx3): include requirement specifiers in the namespace fingerprint

Both numpy>=1.0 and numpy>=2.0 now leave the version unknown, so the
content-derived namespace could not tell the two scans apart. Append the
specifier when present; scans without ranges keep their namespace.
